provenance.replay_note: Per-timestep headings and live-edge state were not persisted by the science runs. They are regenerated here by a deterministic replay of the frozen simulator at the same seed and configuration, and every replayed oracle interface is asserted equal to the frozen file's recorded value. No new statistic is computed.
provenance.selection_rule: R1: minimise sum_m |x_m - median_m| / MAD_m over the reported metrics; ties to the lowest seed id.

L0.label: L0 — fixed interaction graph
L0.note: Every Moore edge is always live. The interface never changes.

L2.label: L2 — heading-dependent FOV
L2.note: A bird sees only the neighbours in front of it, so the interface moves with headings.

L3.label: L3 — FOV + hidden gates
L3.note: Visible edges are additionally gated by a hidden two-state Markov process.

control.caveat: The oracle task was not reliably feasible at this collective size.
